command: A calm GTA San Andreas PS2 interior cutscene with fixed camera. Woman in maroon walks slowly to the burgundy Goji reception table. The Goji team member wearing a fitted black crew-neck T-shirt and black leggings STAYS SEATED behind the table, smiles, gives a small friendly open-hand welcoming gesture, and nods to the arriving woman. Player relaxes her shoulders and returns a small nod. Preserve GOJI wall sign, table, chairs and checked floor. Warm quiet welcome after chaos. No music, no captions. The seated team member has a short dark bob with no ponytail and a gentle smile. Her clothing stays solid black, with a small Goji wordmark printed directly on the left chest. No collar, buttons, name tag or badge. Preserve the outfit and logo in any mirror reflection.

A calm fixed-camera GTA San Andreas interior cutscene. The physiotherapist in a fitted black crew-neck T-shirt and black leggings gently presses her flat upper palm DOWN AND TOWARD SCREEN LEFT on top of the maroon woman's raised upper arm. Her other hand stabilises the right side of the waist. The seated woman exhales and lowers her ribs, head and overhead fingertips down-left into a slightly deeper side bend. Her supporting elbow bends softly, both hips and crossed legs stay planted on the mat. The therapist follows the downward movement, softly straightening her upper elbow while maintaining the same palm contact. They hold the deeper position peacefully for the final two seconds. Therapist maintains her short dark bob and gentle closed-mouth smile. Her clothing stays solid black, with a small Goji wordmark printed directly on the left chest. No collar, buttons, name tag or badge. Preserve the outfit and logo in any mirror reflection.

Calm original GTA San Andreas PS2 low-poly interior cutscene, fixed rear three-quarter camera.
